title: Common
description: Shared value types of the yaran cloud protocol (Phase 02 Design §2). Every other schema file references these by relative $ref.

Uuid.title: Uuid
Uuid.description: Lowercase UUID v4, minted by the Worker.

YaranId.title: YaranId
YaranId.description: Opaque yaran agent or tab id, 1-128 printable ASCII characters.

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with seconds precision and a Z suffix.

P256Point.title: P256Point
P256Point.description: base64url of a 65-byte uncompressed SEC1 P-256 point (0x04 || x || y). The 'B' prefix is the encoding of the 0x04 tag; on-curve is checked in code.

Ed25519PublicKey.title: Ed25519PublicKey
Ed25519PublicKey.description: base64url of a 32-byte raw Ed25519 public key.

OrgUrl.title: OrgUrl
OrgUrl.description: An https origin with no port, path or query.

MachineName.title: MachineName
MachineName.description: Machine name, at most 32 characters, one DNS label fragment.

UserSlug.title: UserSlug
UserSlug.description: The user's hostname slug, at most 30 characters (Phase 05 owns slugging).

OriginPort.title: OriginPort
OriginPort.description: The machine's loopback yaran port ([server] port, default 3890).

DeviceKeyFingerprint.title: DeviceKeyFingerprint
DeviceKeyFingerprint.description: Display fingerprint of a device key P256Point (Design §8.1).

EcdsaP256Sig.title: EcdsaP256Sig
EcdsaP256Sig.description: base64url of a 64-byte raw r || s ECDSA P-256 signature (JWS ES256 form).

InstallId.title: InstallId
InstallId.description: A Uuid the app mints once per org registration on this install.

ProtocolRange.title: ProtocolRange
ProtocolRange.description: A server's supported protocol versions; max >= min is checked in code.

RowStateToken.title: RowStateToken
RowStateToken.description: yaran RowState wire token (row_state.rs), never prose.
